title: Describe committed source size
responsibility: Summarize the sizes recorded in the source tree without reading file content.

inputs.name: hubSize.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubSize.paths
inputs.description: Source paths whose first matching tree-entry sizes are summed.

outputs.name: hubSize
outputs.description: Availability flag and text: total divided by 1024 to one decimal with KB when every size is a safe integer; otherwise source size unavailable, or design only for an empty path list.
